item.title: Google Has Removed MV2 Extensions from the Chrome Web Store, Including UBO
item.description: Google today reached the final milestone in a browser-extension transition that has been years in the making, all remaining Manifest V2 extensions were removed from the Chrome Web Store. (3 sources: frontendfocus, hackernews, javascriptweekly)

item.description: Firefox for iOS now offers an optional Ad Blocker that blocks many third-party ads and trackers, decreasing clutter and distractions. (2 sources: frontendfocus, hackernews)
